title: GrantOpportunityPayload
description: Payload for the GRANT_OPPORTUNITY intent. Surfaces a discovered grant for CEO review with eligibility and effort assessment.

buffer_days_until_deadline.description: Days between now and deadline. Negative or insufficient buffer should trigger refusal upstream.

eligibility_match.description: Subjective fit assessment. 'ineligible' surfaces only for transparency; never proceeds to application.

eligibility_notes.description: Specific eligibility considerations (jurisdiction, stage, sector, other criteria).

estimated_effort_hours.description: Hours to draft and submit. Uncertainty > 2x should be flagged or refused upstream.

evidence_source.description: Public URL where the grant was found. Required for verification.

surfaced_by.description: Almost always agent_grants; could be agent_research.

fit_rationale.description: Why this grant fits the business. Specific reasons, not generic optimism.

risk_factors.description: Known risks: low acceptance rate, complex requirements, conflicting clauses, etc.

next_step_if_approved.description: Concrete next action if CEO approves pursuit.

allOf.description: If amount_min is provided, it must be <= amount_max (logically; not enforced by JSON Schema but documented here for human reviewers).

examples.title: SBA Small Business Innovation Research Phase I
examples.eligibility_notes: U.S.-based <500 employees, technology innovation focus — all confirmed.
examples.fit_rationale: Phase I matches early-stage technical R&D; agentic tooling fits the innovation criterion.
risk_factors: Requires technical narrative reviewed by external researcher
examples.next_step_if_approved: CREATE_TASK to draft Section A (Technical Narrative); request Research support for competitive landscape section.
